channel.title: Performance Benchmarks: Sub-30 Microsecond Rust Content Pipeline
channel.description: Verified Criterion 0.8 micro-benchmarks for NucleusFlow on Apple Silicon (M4, Rust 1.89.0): ~4.2 µs Markdown + YAML parse, ~12.5 µs Handlebars render, ~8.1 µs HTML minification, and ~28.0 µs end-to-end.
